name: hlido-agent-reviews
description: The trust layer for AI agents - C2PA-verified reviews and Laddoo Scores.

endpoints.notes: Stateless JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTPS. POST for tools/list, tools/call, initialize. GET returns server summary.
MCP streamable HTTP transport (spec 2025-03-26). Same endpoint; request/response is stateless JSON-RPC.

tools.name: trust_check
tools.description: One-call Hlido trust answer for a reviewed AI agent. Accepts a slug or full URL, normalizes it, and returns score, tier, blockers, verdict summary, review URL, embed URL, and C2PA trust metadata.

agent_or_url.description: Agent slug or full URL to normalize and look up.

use_case.description: Optional free-text context for the caller's intent.

tools.name: find_trusted
tools.description: Find Hlido-reviewed agents for a free-text need. Matches the need against category, summary, and keywords, then returns ranked trust payloads.

need.description: Free-text intent, such as 'voice agent for SMB outbound'.

min_tier.description: Minimum tier filter. Defaults to STEADY.

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Check whether a claim is present in the agent's server-card and whether Hlido has actually tested it. Returns honest nulls when tested data does not exist.

tools.name: compare_agents
tools.description: Compare multiple AI agents side by side using their Hlido Laddoo Scores, tiers, and verdicts. Pass up to 5 slugs. Returns a ranked comparison with scores and review URLs.

slugs.description: List of agent slugs to compare (max 5).

tools.name: submit_agent
tools.description: Submit an AI agent for Hlido review consideration. Hlido reviews are independent and methodology-driven. Returns a confirmation and next steps.

url.description: Public URL of the agent to review.

name.description: Name of the agent or product.

note.description: Optional context: category, why it matters, or known access details.

tools.name: get_scorecard
tools.description: Fetch the full sanitized claim-vs-evidence scorecard for one slug (schema v1.0). Returns claims with verdicts, source surfaces, and evidence excerpts.

tools.name: report_review_issue
tools.description: Report a stale/wrong/missing claim or broken link on a Hlido review. Routes the issue to the desk's intake queue.

issue.description: Brief description of the problem (stale, wrong, broken link, etc).

tools.name: request_quick_audit
tools.description: Commission a short audit for a NEW agent that has no Hlido review yet. Returns an intake confirmation; turnaround 1-7 days.

tools.name: find_similar_agents
tools.description: Semantic (embedding) search across the review corpus. Returns agents whose summary/category/claims are nearest in vector space.

slug_or_query.description: Either an existing slug (find similar to) or a free-text query.

tools.name: subscribe
tools.description: Preview - Wave 3 will add persistent webhook + RSS subscriptions. For now this returns the agent's current state plus advisory polling instructions (RSS at /changelog/feed.xml or polling /data/attestations/{slug}.json). Use this to register interest in being notified when a slug's verdict changes.

slug.description: The Hlido slug to subscribe to (e.g. 'cursor', 'aider').

channel.description: Preferred notification channel. webhook is advisory only until Wave 3 ships.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Structured natural-language explanation of why a Hlido-reviewed agent has its current score. Pulls claim-by-claim evidence from the published scorecard. Pass an optional dimension to filter; omit for the full picture. Returns each claim with verdict (PASS|FAIL|PARTIAL|UNKNOWN), a quoted evidence snippet (240 chars max), plus a top-line synthesis.

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Constraint-driven recommendation across Hlido's reviewed agents. Pass any combination of category, min_score, tier, use_case, max_results. Returns a ranked shortlist with why_match for each result.
